 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Krishna Prasad Singh, Sr. Advocate

For the State : Mr.Dilip Kumar No. 1, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 3 16-04-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner; learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the informant.

2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Belaganj P.S. Case No. 203 of 2023 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 376(G) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act.
3. The petitioner is accused of committing rape upon the victim who is alleged to be a minor.

4. Mr. Krishna Prasad Singh, learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioner has submitted that the victim has been held to be a major in the medical examination and the medical report does not support the prosecution case.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.9256 of 2024(3) dt.16-04-2024 5.
Learned counsel for the informant and learned APP for the State have opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.
